Thanks for opening a pull request!

Feature pull requests should be associated to a feature proposal to justify the need for implementing the feature in Godot core. Please open a proposal on the [Godot proposals](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals) repository (and link to this pull request in the proposal's body).

Hey! Thanks for the contribution.

I'm not super conviced by those helper functions.
- `get_cell_transform_flags` sounds nice but redundant with `is_cell_flipped_h`, `is_cell_flipped_v` and `is_cell_transposed`. I guess it can be useful for copy-pasting transform, but well, not sure how useful that is.
- `fill_area` and `erase_area` likely only work with squared tiles, and can be worked around with few lines of code (not complicated either). Also, I am not so sure this is a very common use case.

I think the proposal needs more backing before considering merging such helpers.

For the area thing, yes this is not a finished thing but more of an idea and i get the point with the square only thing - good point 

For the function which gets the transform - i thought about redundancy too at first. Thr thing is `is_cell_flipped_h`, `is_cell_flipped_v` and `is_cell_transposed` only return booleans. And based on them you can set a tiles transform when copieng to another location for example (involves checking the flipped bools and transpose and logic based on them). This new method idea merges multiple steps into only one and then returns an int based on the flipped and transposed bools which then can be used to place the same tile type somewhere else while keeping it's transforms. The returned int aka the transform flags can be added as the alternative_tile Parameter to apply the transform to the same or an other tile

Anyways thanks for the productive feedback 👍🏼
